scope: Radio readiness on mainline: the MD answers AT, enables full functionality, reads the SIM and registers on the network. This is the first registration result of the bring-up.

prerequisite_fix.symptom: the first AT round ended when the FS/RPC runner exited on an unaudited property
prerequisite_fix.cause: the MD asked for ro.oppo.operator over RPC (op 0x400f) and the policy had no audited answer, so the backend failed closed and its endpoint close aborted the whole generation with -EPIPE
prerequisite_fix.verification: the complete, unfiltered getprop dump already held for this device (1625 keys, including ro.product.device=op6893) contains no ro.oppo.* key at all
prerequisite_fix.action: ro.oppo.operator added to the audited OBSERVED set as proven absent; the policy is now 35 facts, 25 present and 10 proven absent
prerequisite_fix.note: a live getprop re-check on Android is still pending; the evidence used is the full dump from this build

sequence: AT+CFUN=1 -> OK plus a URC burst: +ESMLSTATUS, +ECEMODE, +ECEVDP, +EHVOLTE, +ECAPABILITY, +EPOK, +ECT3G, +EUSIM, +ESIMECC

final_state.interpretation: EPS registration status 1 = registered on the home network, TAC 0x9A17, cell 0x03C341C3, AcT 7 = LTE
final_state.cs_note: CS registration stays denied, which is expected for an LTE-only attach with no CS fallback configured; the EPS domain is registered

not_claimed: any data plane: no CCMNI netdev and no CCB channels exist, so no PDP context can carry traffic
next: CCB control area plus the CCMNI netdev are the two missing pieces for data
a live getprop re-check for ro.oppo.operator when Android is next up
